FQHESphereWithSU3SpinLValue, version 0.01

Usage: FQHESphereWithSU3SpinLValue [options] 

Options:

system options:
    --state : name of the file that contains the state whose average L value has to be evaluated

    -t, --total-tz : twice the quantum number of the system associated to the Tz generator (default value = 0)
    -y, --total-y : three time the quantum number of the system associated to the Y generator (default value = 0)
    --statistics : particle statistics (bosons or fermions, try to guess it from file name if not defined)
    --lzsymmetrized-basis : use Lz <-> -Lz symmetrized version of the basis (only valid if total-lz=0)
    --tzsymmetrized-basis : use Tz <-> -Tz symmetrized version of the basis (only valid if total-tz=0)
    --z3symmetrized-basis : use Z3 symmetrized version of the basis (only valid if total-y=0 and total-tz=0)
    --minus-tzparity : select the  Tz <-> -Tz symmetric sector with negative parity
    --minus-lzparity : select the  Lz <-> -Lz symmetric sector with negative parity
    --show-extracted : show values extracted from file name

parallelization options:
    -S, --SMP : enable SMP mode
    --processors : number of processors to use in SMP mode (default value = 2)
    --smp-profil : enable SMP profiling, the name of the log file  has to be passed as argument

precalculation options:
    --save-hilbert : save Hilbert space description in the indicated file and exit (only available for the Haldane basis)
    --load-hilbert : load Hilbert space description from the indicated file (only available for the Haldane basis)

misc options:
